name.value: The Golden Horn Turkish Bakery & Cafe

description.value: The Golden Horn is a 100% Halal Turkish bakery and café located at Canada Place on Vancouver's seawall, serving handcrafted baklavas made from in-house yufka dough, boreks, pide-wrapped durums, and traditional Turkish coffee. The Canada Place location is steps from the harbour and offers stunning views of the mountains, making it a natural stop on any seawall cycling route. The menu spans sweet pastries through to hearty sandwiches and platters.

raw_osm.name: The Golden Horn Turkish Bakery & Cafe

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM record: the Locations & Hours page confirms this Canada Place location at 40-1055 Canada Pl, Vancouver V6C 0C3 with phone (604) 647-7550, matching the OSM tags exactly. The site confirms the business is open, offers takeout and online ordering, and the menu shows vegetarian options (Veggie Curry, Veggie Iskender, Chickpea Durum) and dairy-free baklava. No bike-specific amenities (parking, water refill, wi-fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Online ordering page defaults to pickup from the Cambie St location only; it is unclear whether the Canada Place location supports online pickup or delivery orders independently.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible café on the Vancouver seawall at Canada Place — a high-traffic cycling corridor. Confirmed operating with full menu and online ordering.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business is 100% Halal certified per website homepage. OSM outdoor_seating=yes and indoor_seating=yes are corroborated by website description of seating areas at both locations.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Veggie Curry, Veggie Iskender, Chickpea Durum, and Spinach & Feta; Coconut & Almond Baklava is explicitly marked Dairy Free

wow_evidence: Canada Place on Vancouver's seawall… steps from the harbour
